1NF avoids repeating groups and uses atomic values for the model. 2NF removes partial dependencies on
candidate keys. 3NF removes inappropriate transitive dependencies of non-key attributes.

Jකාටසකට පමණක් depend වන data Jවන් කරෙනවා. 3NF එJකන් non-key column අතරෙ අනවශ්‍ය
Instead of repeating customer name in every order item, store it once in customers.

Before: repeated customer information · order_id customer_id customer_name · 101 1 Kamal · 102 1 Kamal · ↓ split by dependency ↓ · customer_id (PK) name · order_id (PK) customer_id (FK) · 1 Kamal · 101 1 · 102 1

Repeated customer names move into customers; orders retain only the reference. This demonstrates removal of a
transitive dependency (3NF).
Diagram එJක් boxes සහ arrows අනුව සම්බන්ධතාවය Jහහෝ පියවරෙ මාලාව බලන්න.

-- Split an order line into related tables:
-- customers(id, name)
-- orders(id, customer_id)
-- items(order_id, product_id, qty)
Expected result: Customer names are maintained in one place; line quantities depend on the line key.

Interview question: Why normalize?
Answer: To reduce redundancy and insertion, update and deletion anomalies.
Remember: Atomic / full key / no transitive dependency.
Practice: Normalize a table with student, course and teacher data.
